name: JNBY Design Limited
summary: JNBY Design Limited, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the design, promotion, and sale of female, male, and youth contemporary apparel, footwear, and accessories in the People's Republic of China and internationally. It operates in three segments: Mature Brand, Younger Brands, and Emerging Brands. The company offers contemporary apparel, footwear, and accessories for women, men, and children, as well as household products under the JNBY, CROQUIS, jnby by JNBY, LESS, POMME DE TERRE, JNBYHOME, onmygame, RE;RE;RE;LAB, and B1OCK brands.
